issues.detail: The Hebrew has a double oath formula: 'As I live... surely, because you have hated blood, blood will pursue you' (אִם לֹא דָם שָׂנֵאתָ וְדָם יִרְדְּפֶךָ). The particle אִם לֹא here is an oath formula meaning 'surely/indeed' (literally 'if not'), not a conditional 'if you do not'. The Vietnamese renders it as 'nếu ngươi không ghét máu' ('if you do not hate blood'), which reverses the meaning: the Hebrew states that because you hated blood, blood will pursue you; the Vietnamese makes it conditional on not hating blood, changing the claim.
